newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index ends higher in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index ends higher in light trade.

text.p: The Philippine share index closed 17.11 points higher, or 0.58 percent, at 2,944.98 points on Friday as blue chips showed a technical rebound but overall sentiment was negative, traders said.

"There was no panic selling because volume was low but what was also lacking was a stimulating buying spree. Most of second and thirdliners were neglected," said Irving Ackerman, president at I. Ackerman & Co Inc.
Value turnover was a modest 1.62 billion pesos.
Despite the main index's rise, decliners swamped gainers 74 to 44 with 70 issues unchanged in the broad market.
The property and mining sub-indices fell while commercial-industrial, finance, and oil sector recovered. The all-share index was little changed.

Concerns over a glut in the property sector, sent Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc to its year low close at 5.30 pesos while its unit Empire East Land Holdings Inc hit its lowest level, finishing at 5.20 pesos.
"I think that there wil be a rebound next week since really most issues are oversold," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Securities.
Week-on-week, the main index shed 31.8 points, or 1.07 percent, to 2,976.78 points from last Friday's close of 2,944.98.
